description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release lets you install SRN Harness plugins such as superpowers into Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, gives each conversation its own model and reasoning effort settings, fixes several to-do task issues and a server hang on network-mounted folders, updates Claude Code to 0.110.0, Codex to 2.10.0 and many other agents, and further reduces memory use.
New
- You can now install SRN Harness plugins such as superpowers from Discover in one step. For each agent, choose to install it as a plugin, as skills only, or not at all. Supported agents are Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.
- Installed plugins have their own section on the Harness Engineering page. There you can see each plugin's version and status for each agent, update, repair or uninstall it, and enable, disable or switch its mode per agent. A plugin that SRN Harness no longer vouches for is disabled automatically, and its files are kept.
- Discover can now be filtered to show only plugins, and the Harness Engineering entry in the sidebar shows what it manages.
Improved
- Each conversation now keeps its own model, reasoning effort and mode, so changing them in one chat no longer changes other chats when they reconnect. To-do tasks keep the agent and settings they were created with, and reruns continue in the same conversation. (#1293; #1179 reported by @bosund)
- Updated Claude Code (claude-agent-acp) to 0.110.0, Codex (codex-acp) to 2.10.0, Cline to 3.0.75, Grok to 1.0.92, Hermes to 0.23.3, Kimi Code to 2.7.2, Cursor to 2026.11.22, Antigravity to 1.5.2, ZCode to 0.92.0, Command Code to 1.93.2 and pi to 0.0.35. When an agent's models support different reasoning effort levels, the model list now shows each model's range.
- Plugin and skill install dialogs are clearer. They now show requested permissions, everything that runs automatically and the package contents. You can also set the install mode for all agents at once.
Fixed
- Fixed several to-do task issues. The "Complete task" dialog no longer says nothing changed when the branch has commits. Task folders now match on Windows regardless of drive-letter case. The merge prompt now follows the "Delete worktree after merge" option. Auto-merge no longer waits on a busy task or merges a task someone is still working in. (#1290; #1166, #1167, #1168 reported by @grykom)
- codeg-server no longer stops accepting connections when a workspace folder is on a slow network mount such as SSHFS. (#1294; #1292 reported by @Kevinzz224)
- Antigravity commands still running in the background are no longer stopped after a turn ends. Their results now come back to the conversation, and they appear in the running-task list. (#1286, @moncha3)
- Skipping a question from Antigravity now ends the turn properly instead of leaving it stuck.
- Forking a Codex conversation from a reply with memory citations now works and starts from the selected reply. (#1289, @Cuinnchen)
- When you type a custom answer to a DeepSeek question, the conversation now shows it instead of "Not selected". (#1285, @ana52070)
- Local images in Markdown previews now display when their paths contain non-ASCII characters or are absolute. (#1142, @frankewang)
- The desktop pet keeps its size and shape on setups that mix high-resolution and standard displays. It also returns to the right monitor and remembers its position after you quit. (#1211, @Cuinnchen)
- pi no longer uses your first message as the conversation's custom title. Renaming with /name still works.
- Reduced memory retained by cached skill lists, agent option checks, live logs, account avatars, browser downloads and animations. Hidden tabs also stop tracking text selection in the background. (#1214, #1216, #1217, #1223, #1228, #1230, #1233, #1235, @kogekiplay)
Thanks to @kogekiplay, @Cuinnchen, @moncha3, @ana52070 and @frankewang for contributing to this release, and to @bosund, @grykom and @Kevinzz224 for the reports.
